title: The Gravity of Halcyon Drift Revisited
author: Tamsin Iversen
blurb: Orsen Pemberton, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
